cells.scene: A disconnected old appliance and a visibly blown replaceable fuse lie beside a dark unlit lamp, focus on electrical failure, no live wiring or how-to.
An old wooden chair leans unevenly with loose joints and a wobbly leg, visibly unstable, no person sitting on it.
A sink drain is clogged with a small visible accumulation of food scraps while water pools in the basin; no dismantling instructions.
An adult admiring themselves as a champion carpenter in a thought bubble actually stands beside a crooked broken chair they made.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — fuse (v.由于烧断保险丝而短路): A disconnected old appliance and a visibly blown replaceable fuse lie beside a dark unlit lamp, focus on electrical failure, no live wiring or how-to.
TOP RIGHT — rickety (a.要散架的，晃动的): An old wooden chair leans unevenly with loose joints and a wobbly leg, visibly unstable, no person sitting on it.
BOTTOM LEFT — clog (v.堵塞): A sink drain is clogged with a small visible accumulation of food scraps while water pools in the basin; no dismantling instructions.
BOTTOM RIGHT — delusion (n.错觉): An adult admiring themselves as a champion carpenter in a thought bubble actually stands beside a crooked broken chair they made.
review_notes: All cells visually reviewed: blown fuse with disconnected appliances, unstable chair and blocked drain match the meanings. Delusion correctly contrasts imagined skill with poor actual work, but thought-bubble edge enters horizontal crop boundary; that cell superseded by repair-late-001.
